coordinates.locator: MINOS atmospheric muon charge-ratio paper, detector description
coordinates.note: The MINOS detector paper independently gives "located in Soudan, MN (47.8∘ N latitude, and 92.2∘ W longitude), 735.3 km from the NuMI beam production target"; the more precise value is used.

depth.quote: The detector is housed in a specially excavated cavern, 705 m underground (2070 meters-water-equivalent)

depth_mwe.quote: The detector is housed in a specially excavated cavern, 705 m underground (2070 meters-water-equivalent)

summary.plain: The purpose-built cavern half a mile underground in the old Soudan iron mine that held the MINOS far detector, 735 kilometres from the neutrino beam that was aimed at it.
summary.technical: Excavated hall on the 27th level of the Soudan mine at 705 m depth (2070 m.w.e.), 735.3 km from the NuMI production target, which housed the 5.4 kt magnetised MINOS far detector.
